name: tabtree
description: Read your TabTree library and build mind maps, kanban boards and whiteboards from a conversation.
long_description:
Tell Claude "turn these meeting notes into a mind map", "make a kanban for the launch with these tasks" or "draw our database schema as a board", and the result appears in your TabTree account — on your laptop and your phone, and in your team spaces for every member.

Ask it to "add these three tasks to the sprint board, for Sara, due Friday" and they appear on the board by themselves within seconds, while TabTree is open — Cmd+Z undoes them. Changes that rewrite or remove what someone wrote (renaming, deleting, rewriting a note) are shown to you first, as a banner on that map: you tick what you want and apply it.

To connect: paste your connector key below. Create it in TabTree → Settings → Account → Claude connector.

The connector never overwrites or deletes a map, and never touches your browser storage.

tools.name: list_maps
tools.description: Lists every map, kanban and board in your TabTree account and your team spaces.

tools.name: read_map
tools.description: Reads one map — a mind map as a markdown outline, a board as elements and connections.

tools.name: search_maps
tools.description: Searches map names, nodes, notes, shapes and sticky notes across the library.

tools.name: create_mindmap
tools.description: Creates a new mind map from a markdown outline — with screenshots on nodes if you pass image files.

tools.name: create_board
tools.description: Creates a new whiteboard with shapes and anchored arrows.

tools.name: create_kanban
tools.description: Creates a new kanban board — columns and cards with owners, dates, labels, estimates and sub-tasks.

tools.name: propose_changes
tools.description: Changes an existing map or kanban — safe changes apply by themselves, the rest is shown to you for approval.

tools.name: harvest
tools.description: Keeps what matters from a conversation — facts, decisions, lessons — in your Company knowledge and Lessons maps, after you accept it in TabTree.

api_key.title: TabTree connector key
api_key.description: Paste the key from TabTree → Settings → Account → Claude connector (it starts with tt_live_).

backup_folder.title: Legacy: TabTree Classic folder
backup_folder.description: Only for the discontinued TabTree Classic (local file). Leave empty.
